blocks.html: Jump the map straight to a grid reference, lat-lon, or street address - and drop a marker there if you want.

slides.title: Open Go To and pick a format
slides.html: Select the Go To icon. Pick your format tab: MGRS (grid), DD / DM / DMS (lat-lon), UTM, or ADDR (address).

slides.title: Enter the coordinates
slides.html: Type the location into the fields. Tap Cycle to combine Easting/Northing into one field, then the whole coordinate into one large field for fast entry.

slides.title: Set the elevation
slides.html: Enter elevation in the space provided, or tap Pull Elevation to fill it from the map's elevation source if one is loaded.

slides.title: Jump to an address
slides.html: On the ADDR tab, type the address and tap Find. It drops a marker or pans the map there. Tick Set the address as the title to use the address as the marker label.
